display.purpose: The name in the identity column, once per page; 3.2rem from 640px.

headline.purpose: Section titles: Selected work, About, Skills, Let's talk.

subtitle.purpose: Sub-lists inside a section: More projects, Now.

lead.purpose: The role line under the name, in Ink.

body-large.purpose: Intro, bio and contact text, in Graphite.

body.purpose: Each project's one-sentence summary; the hero line at 32ch.

body-small.purpose: Row text, notes, diagram copy; expanded 'How it works' text at 15px/1.75.

meta.purpose: The line under a project title, in Slate.

caption.purpose: Diagram titles; the figure's caption strip uses 13px at 400.

nav.purpose: Desktop section nav only, uppercase. Tracking resets to 0 on Arabic.

link.purpose: Outbound links and the 'How it works' disclosure.

data.purpose: Stat values and result percentages; standalone figures only.

data-small.purpose: Version tags, list years, ranks, step numbers, averages (11.5-13px).

arabic.purpose: All Arabic text; same sizes as the Latin roles, never letter-spaced.

shadows.name: device-lift
shadows.purpose: Phone frames around app screenshots. The only shadow besides window-lift.

shadows.name: window-lift
shadows.purpose: Browser-window frame and the admin-dashboard screenshot in the order journey.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); translateY(8px) and opacity 0 to rest; delays 0.06s, 0.12s, 0.2s
motion.purpose: Identity column entrance on load, once.

motion.name: hover-colour
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on hover.

motion.name: nav-line
motion.purpose: Section nav marker for hover and the section in view.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.value: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.3s, scaleX(0) to 1 from the reading start
motion.purpose: Result bars fill once when their project scrolls into view.

motion.name: journey-step
motion.value: 5.2s linear per step, plays through once while on screen
motion.purpose: Order journey track fill; a tap holds the step.

motion.name: figure-wave
motion.value: 2.4s wave, 0.9s settle, then rest; alert at 60% of the speed meter
motion.purpose: Pose figure: the one signature motion. Pointer-driven after the wave; frames stop when still.

components.css: .ds-fig { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e6e5e2); background: var(--sunken, #f3f3f1); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Schibsted Grotesk", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-fig-stage { height: 250px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 16px 16px 14px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-fig-svg { height: 172px; width: auto; flex: none; } .ds-fig-bones { fill: none; stroke: var(--fig-line, #1f1f23); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-fig-joint { fill: var(--fig-joint, #fbfbfa); stroke: var(--fig-line, #1f1f23); stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-fig-face { fill: var(--fig-line, #1f1f23); } .ds-fig-strip { margin-top: auto; width: 100%; } .ds-fig-label { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fig-label, #5b5b63); } .ds-fig-track { position: relative; margin-top: 8px; height: 4px; background: var(--fig-track, #e2e1de); } .ds-fig-fill { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; width: 8%; background: var(--fig-line, #1f1f23); } .ds-fig-mark { position: absolute; top: -5px; inset-inline-start: calc(60% - 1px); width: 2px; height: 14px; background: var(--fig-mark, #d97706); } .ds-fig-cap { padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e6e5e2); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--text-2, #52525b); }

narrative.overview:
This is the engineer-portfolio grammar every recruiter already knows: a pinned identity column beside a scrolling column of work. It is executed with restraint, not reinvented. There is no theme and no costume. The page is near-white, or near-black when the system is dark, with one grotesque typeface, neutral greys and a single blue. The interest comes from the work itself: real screenshots in device frames, small diagrams that show how each system decides, and numbers set in mono so they read as data.

Density is calm. Desktop has one reading column at about half the container. Sections are well apart (80 to 112px), hairlines separate rows instead of boxes, and soft sunken panels appear only where there is something to look at. Every surface flips with `prefers-color-scheme` through the same named tokens. The Arabic page at /ar mirrors the English one completely; it is not a translation dropped into a left-to-right layout.

One element is allowed to perform: the live pose figure at the top of the work column. It is a canvas skeleton that waves once, rests, reaches for the pointer, and trips a red alert when moved fast. Everything else is quiet and moves once at most. The look stays professional and familiar, as PRODUCT.md commits, and never becomes a themed or costume world.
keyCharacteristics: Sticky identity column on desktop; a single column with sticky section bars on phones.
Near-white or near-black ground, neutral greys, one blue accent, and an ink-coloured primary pill.
Schibsted Grotesk for every Latin word, JetBrains Mono only for standalone data, and Noto Sans Arabic for Arabic.
A flat page: tone and 1px hairlines make the depth, and only device frames cast shadows.
Full pills for actions and chips; soft 14px panels for screenshots and diagrams.
English and Arabic as equals, with logical properties and mirrored motion.
One signature motion, the pose figure; everything else moves once or not at all.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue that is not a status colour. It marks links, highlights and focus, always as small marks. It never fills a section, a panel or a button.

rules.name: The Ink Pill Rule
rules.body: The primary action is ink on the ground: a `text` fill with a `bg` label. It inverts with the theme and is never blue.

rules.name: The Dots-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear as 6px status dots and inside the pose figure, and nowhere else. They are never text colour, fills or decoration on the page.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Every Latin word on both pages is set in Schibsted Grotesk. Hierarchy comes from size, weight (400, 500 or 600) and negative tracking, never from a second display face.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets only standalone figures: versions, stat values, percentages, list years, ranks and step numbers. A number inside a sentence or a meta line ("Android app · 2026") stays in the sans. On /ar each mono value is wrapped in `dir="ltr"`.

rules.name: The No Tracking In Arabic Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing breaks Arabic letter joining, so any tracked style resets to 0 on Arabic text. The stylesheet enforces this for every tracking class.

rules.name: The Email In Reach Rule
rules.body: Every scroll position has a visible way to email: the Email me pill in the pinned identity column on desktop, or the mail button in the sticky section bar on phones.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Anything with a direction, in layout or in motion, uses logical properties or flips under `dir="rtl"`. Nothing is pinned to left or right.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: The page, panels, pills, tags and buttons never cast shadows. A shadow means "this is a device or a window" and nothing else.

dos: **Do** keep a single ink pill (`text` fill, `bg` label, 999px, 2.75rem) as the primary action, with a mail or download icon and a verb.
**Do** put every screenshot and diagram in a panel: a `sunken` ground, a 1px `line` border and 14px corners.
**Do** set standalone figures in JetBrains Mono next to a sans label, and wrap them in `dir="ltr"` on the Arabic page.
**Do** reference colour tokens (`var(--text)`, `text-text-2`) so every component flips with the system theme. Keep literal colours for the device bezel and the frame shadows only.
**Do** use logical properties (start/end, inline-start/end) and mirror any directional motion under `dir="rtl"`.
**Do** give every interactive element a 44px target and the 2px `accent` focus outline at a 3px offset.
**Do** keep motion to a single play, behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, starting from a visible default.
**Do** write the name "Hussein Al Herk" in Latin script, left to right, in Schibsted Grotesk on both pages.
donts: **Don't** introduce a themed or costume world: no material metaphor, period ornament, decorative texture or illustrative chrome. The look stays professional and familiar.
**Don't** add a second accent hue, or use blue for the primary button, a panel or a section background.
**Don't** use green, amber or red as text, fills or decoration outside status dots and the pose figure.
**Don't** give panels, pills, tags or buttons a shadow; shadows belong to device and window frames.
**Don't** set headings, prose or labels in JetBrains Mono.
**Don't** reuse the nav's uppercase tracked label as an eyebrow above headings; uppercase belongs to the desktop section nav alone.
**Don't** add looping or autoplaying motion beyond the figure's single wave and the order journey's single play-through.
**Don't** show screens or brand marks that PRODUCT.md withholds (the private financial app, the shop client's brand).
